---
title: A Lot to Ask
hook_line: A meteor is a lot to ask
central_image: a flask of cocoa going cold on a flat roof under an empty sky
arc: [climb to the roof with the forecast's promise, nothing falls and the night fills with substitutes, dawn arrives and the looking was the point]
title_rationale: the hook admits the request was unreasonable and keeps the wry tone the brief asks for
---

## Notes

The verses collect the small failures of the night (an alarm, a blanket, a plane mistaken for a streak). The chorus names what the listener actually brought: patience and a flask. The bridge lets the dawn arrive without a single meteor and lets that be enough.
